BASTION ULTRAWIDE — INSTALL
===========================

The core fix is a binary patch to Bastion.exe, so it can't be shipped as a plain
drop-in file (it's your own game binary, and it's tied to your resolution). You
apply it by running the patcher in ../src against your Bastion.exe.

STEP 1 — Patch the exe (needs the .NET 8 SDK: https://dotnet.microsoft.com)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Open PowerShell in the repo's  Bastion/src  folder and run:

    dotnet run -- --exe "C:\Games\Solo\Bastion\Bastion.exe" --width 5120 --height 1440

  - Change --exe to wherever your Bastion.exe lives.
  - Change --width/--height for a different ultrawide resolution.
  - Safe to re-run: it restores from a stock backup each time before patching.
  - A stock backup (Bastion.exe.orig-backup) is created next to your exe on first run.

STEP 2 — Copy the launcher (this folder) into your game folder
--------------------------------------------------------------
Copy  "Launch Bastion (5120x1440 borderless).bat"  next to Bastion.exe.

STEP 3 — Play
-------------
  1. Double-click the .bat (or make a desktop shortcut to it).
  2. In-game: Options > Video > set resolution to 5120x1440
     (it replaces the old 1920x1200 entry).

Result: full-width gameplay, correctly-sized HUD/menus/subtitles centered in a
16:9 band, full-width parallax backdrop.

If anything looks wrong, restore Bastion.exe.orig-backup over Bastion.exe and
re-run the patcher. See ../notes.md for full details.
